title: Fix Semio Algorithms Story Infinite Loading
description: The drag story in semio/algorithms Storybook infinitely loads and refreshing does not recover. Reproduce the loop, fix the underlying runtime/state bug, update the existing tests, and verify Storybook behavior end-to-end.
summary: Stopped the semio algorithms drag story from infinitely loading by fixing UI find-item synchronization so it no longer re-writes an equivalent empty array into context on every render, which had been causing a maximum-update-depth loop in the shared UI shell. Also hardened UICanvas async cleanup and added regression coverage for both behaviors. Verified the drag Storybook iframe reaches readyState complete and renders content in a scripted browser run, and lint/test commands for @semio/algorithms complete successfully.
